title: Lessons from Investigation into Death of Student during Height-based Activity
what_it_is: Lessons from Investigation into Death of Student during Height-based Activity

sections.label: SAFRA Yishun adventure activity death
sections.summary: Jethro's class took part in an annual school activity at SAFRA Yishun's adventure facility, operated by Camelot Pte Ltd, since 2017; the death cause is under Police investigation and MOE review.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Jethro and his class were involved in an activity at the adventure facility in SAFRA Yishun, which is operated by Camelot Pte Ltd.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: This is an annual activity that the school has been undertaking for its students since 2017.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: We are unable to comment on the specifics of the incident as the cause of Jethro’s death is still being investigated by the Police.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: MOE is also undertaking its own review on the conduct of height-based outdoor education.
